title: One column short is silent, not an error
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
var layout = [ { name: "name", start: 6, length: 19 } ]
fun field(line, start, length) = trim(line[start to (start + length - 1)])
---
field("E00002Bartholomew Chen III0001500.75SAL", 6, 19)

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
var layout = [ { name: "name", start: 6, length: 19 } ]
fun field(line, start, length) = trim(line[start to (start + length - 1)])
---
field("E00002Bartholomew Chen III0001500.75SAL", 6, 19)

explanation.approach: r2's name is exactly 20 characters — "Bartholomew Chen III" — with no padding to spare. Reading only 19 of them drops the trailing "I" and returns a different, still-plausible-looking name. No exception, no null — just a wrong answer, and only on the one row with no slack in it.
